## Projects & Case Studies
- [Absensi RSUD Mangusada Bali](https://wildansilki.xyz/projects/absensi-rsd): High-reliability mobile attendance platform featuring on-device facial recognition (TensorFlow Lite) and anti-spoofing polygon geofencing coordinate verification for hospital staff. Built with Flutter, Dart, and Firebase.
- [Token Vendor](https://wildansilki.xyz/projects/token-vendor): Autonomous decentralized automated vending protocol and ERC-20 token purchase machine on Ethereum. Engineered with Solidity, Hardhat, and OpenZeppelin CEI security patterns.
- [MIT Profiling](https://wildansilki.xyz/projects/mit-profiling): LinkedIn-style corporate talent profiling platform, organizational capability directory, and portfolio tracking system built for PT Merkle Inovasi Teknologi using Node.js, Express, and TypeScript.
- [Blayu Mobile](https://wildansilki.xyz/projects/blayu-mobile): Cross-platform Flutter mobile application for football academy management, young athlete curriculum tracking, pitch attendance, and performance analytics.
- [Simple NFT](https://wildansilki.xyz/projects/simple-nft): Gas-optimized ERC-721 non-fungible token smart contract with decentralized IPFS metadata storage on Ethereum blockchain.
- [MaYPI Platform](https://wildansilki.xyz/projects/maypi-platform): Industrial web platform for digital water meter reading, real-time consumption volume monitoring, and automated utility billing telemetry built with React.js and Node.js.
- [Tani Cerdas](https://wildansilki.xyz/projects/tani-cerdas): Modern agricultural management platform empowering farmers and agricultural cooperatives to manage agricultural data digitally to improve productivity and welfare using Next.js and MongoDB.

## Technical Articles & Engineering Journal
- [Securing EVM Smart Contracts: Defending Against Reentrancy and State Pitfalls](https://wildansilki.xyz/blog/solidity-smart-contract-security): A practical deep dive into smart contract defensive programming, the Checks-Effects-Interactions (CEI) pattern, and storage layout optimization.
- [Algorithmic Risk Management: The Math Behind Capital Preservation](https://wildansilki.xyz/blog/algorithmic-trading-risk-management): How quantitative risk rules, dynamic position sizing, and volatility-adjusted stops prevent ruin in algorithmic execution engines.
- [On-Device Biometric Verification in Flutter: High Accuracy at 60 FPS](https://wildansilki.xyz/blog/flutter-biometric-face-recognition): Engineering lessons from building Absensi RSD: running TensorFlow Lite facial embeddings on background Dart isolates without freezing UI threads.
- [Hyper-Gemma AI Trader: Autonomous Bitget Futures Execution with Trinity v2 Quant Engine](https://wildansilki.xyz/blog/hyper-gemma-ai-trader): Architecture deep dive into Hyper-Gemma AI Trader (Trinity v2): engineering a Pure Quant Tactical Engine (Z-Score, Hurst Exponent, VWAP, Kalman Filter) with passive Gemma 4 AI for zero-latency, hallucination-free cryptocurrency futures execution.
- [Quantitative Strategy Research on TradingView: Prototyping Trinity with Pine Script v5](https://wildansilki.xyz/blog/tradingview-pine-script-quant-research): How we prototyped and backtested the Trinity Quant Engine on TradingView using Pine Script v5: implementing rolling Z-Score mean reversion, Hurst fractal regime filters, and dynamic ATR risk budgeting before deploying to TypeScript production.
